scope: same saved validation frames; online synthetic weather; no training or OPV2V-W test
source_interpretation: Source-only heads are standalone proxies. Leave-one-peer-out is a conditional full-forward effect; it renormalizes remaining sources and is not additive causal attribution. GT quality changes are post-hoc only.

stage0_gate.rule: Every weather and both arms: p90 <= 256 candidates/frame and >= 90% of all-geometry IoU70 GT coverage after range filtering.
